description: Flight bookings are cancelled on MAQAMI's website, not in this chat. When a customer wants to cancel a flight, give them https://book.maqami.co/manage-bookings and tell them to continue from there: choose "Flight reservations", enter the last name and the booking ID, then follow the steps to see the refund and cancel. Calling this tool returns the same link and steps.

bookingId.description: Optional: the flight booking ID, if the customer gave it.
